description.value: Firehouse Subs is a sandwich chain serving hot toasted subs, operating out of a single-storey building in Fort St. John's commercial corridor on 96A Street. The brand is notable for its Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation, which has donated over $100 million in lifesaving equipment to first responders. Takeout is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Peace River region.
